AI Meeting Assistants

tl;dv

tl;dv records and transcribes online meetings, generates AI notes and multi-meeting insights, and connects conversation data to sales and workflow tools.

What is tl;dv?

tl;dv is an AI meeting assistant designed for meeting capture plus downstream conversation intelligence. Its free tier covers ongoing recording and transcription with capped AI usage, while paid plans unlock unlimited AI notes, broader search, integrations, automation and sales-oriented multi-meeting analysis.

Best for: Teams that want generous meeting recording plus AI notes, CRM automation and cross-meeting intelligence for sales or customer workflows.

Main features

  • Meeting recording and transcription
  • AI-generated notes and Ask tl;dv
  • Multi-meeting reports
  • Clips and highlights
  • CRM and workflow integrations
  • Sales coaching and playbook features on higher plans
  • Public API and webhooks

Use cases

  • Record and transcribe online meetings
  • Generate recurring AI meeting notes
  • Search conversations across many meetings
  • Push call data into CRM workflows
  • Analyze sales objections and playbook adherence

Who is it for?

  • sales teams
  • customer-success teams
  • remote teams
  • recruiters
  • revenue operations

Pricing and plans

freemium subscription

Starting price: USD 18 / seat/month, billed annually for Pro; $29 on monthly billing

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Free plan provides unlimited recording and transcription with capped AI features
  • Pro adds extensive integrations and unlimited AI-note usage
  • Public API and webhooks support automation

Limitations

  • Free-tier AI notes and Ask AI usage are capped
  • Some free meeting data is subject to retention/archive limits
  • The public API is currently labeled v1alpha1 and may change

Frequently asked questions

Does tl;dv have a permanent free plan?

Yes. tl;dv's current official material lists a Free Forever plan with unlimited recording and transcription while capping AI-note and Ask AI usage.

How much is tl;dv Pro?

Current official tl;dv material lists Pro at $18 per seat per month when billed annually and $29 on month-to-month billing.

Is the tl;dv API production-stable?

A public API exists, but the official documentation currently identifies it as v1alpha1, so integrations should allow for possible API changes.
